Stewart & Patten Co Llc bought 5,530 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.26% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 95,759 shares of the transportation company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $11.50 million, up from 90,229 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stewart & Patten Co Llc who had been investing in United Parcel Service for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $94.65 billion market cap company.
